trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The canonical base fact layer contains no drawing approval history or approval date.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer to check represented topology, equipment attributes, or rule-pack conditions.

questions.question: What did the last field inspection find?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The drawing facts contain no field-inspection records.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer checks that can be made from the represented equipment and connectivity.

questions.question: What is the pump discharge pressure right now?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: A static engineering drawing does not provide live operating measurements.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer to identify represented pressure instrumentation or design attributes.

questions.question: When is the next maintenance shutdown?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The drawing facts contain no maintenance schedule.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer drawing-based equipment or connectivity checks instead.

questions.question: Why did the operator stop this pump yesterday?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The drawing has no event timeline or operator log.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer to inspect the represented pump connections and safeguards.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The request is unrelated to the loaded engineering source.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Briefly offer source-grounded P&ID topology or equipment checks.

questions.question: Will it rain at the plant tomorrow?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The drawing is not a weather-data source.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer checks over plant equipment represented in the drawing.

questions.question: What will the vendor's stock price be next month?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: Financial forecasts are unrelated to the loaded engineering source.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer to identify vendor or equipment attributes only if represented.

questions.question: How much should the pump operator be paid?

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: Compensation decisions are outside drawing-grounded analysis.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer equipment, connectivity, or represented-rule checks.

questions.question: Translate this sentence into Japanese: the meeting starts at noon.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The request does not concern the loaded engineering source.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Offer a concise menu of source-grounded drawing checks.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The requested safety criterion and scope are not specified.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Ask for a criterion and offer specific topology or rule-pack checks.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: Neither the candidate objects nor the violated condition are identified.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Ask which objects or rule to compare and offer available drawing checks.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: No line identity or acceptance criterion is supplied.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Ask for the line and criterion, then offer connectivity or attribute checks.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: Approval authority and criteria are not defined by the drawing.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Clarify that approval needs an authority and offer evidence checks from the source.

trap_rubric.refusal_basis: The desired engineering task and decision context are unspecified.
trap_rubric.redirect_target: Ask what needs evaluation and offer concrete source-grounded checks.
